description: This file defines a store for managing bot entities in a Mattermost server, including methods for retrieving, saving, updating, and deleting bot records in the database.

classes.name: SqlBotStore
classes.description: A store for managing bot records in the database, providing methods for CRUD operations and queries.

methods.name: newSqlBotStore
methods.description: Creates a new instance of SqlBotStore with initialized query builder.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Fetches a bot by user ID, optionally including deleted bots.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Retrieves all bots matching specified options such as owner ID, deletion status, and pagination.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Persists a new bot record into the database.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an existing bot record in the database.

methods.name: PermanentDelete
methods.description: Deletes a bot record from the database permanently.

methods.name: GetAllAfter
methods.description: Retrieves a list of bots with user IDs greater than a specified ID, limited by count.

methods.name: GetByUsername
methods.description: Fetches a bot by its username.
